name: Eigenmath
author: George Weigt
description: Eigenmath, symbolic math in the Terminal: derivatives, integrals, equations, matrices and exact numbers of any size. Type eigenmath for the prompt, or eigenmath -e 'd(sin(x)^2,x)' for one answer.
usage: eigenmath -e 'EXPR' [-e 'EXPR'...] (one-line results) | eigenmath FILE | eigenmath (prompt). d(f,x) derivative, integral(f,x), defint(f,x,a,b), roots(p) exact, nroots(p) numeric, simplify(e), rationalize(e), float(e), taylor(f,x,n), inv(m), det(m), sum(k,1,10,f) and product(k,1,10,f) with numeric bounds. Results are expanded. Example: eigenmath -e 'integral(x^2*exp(x),x)'

descriptions.en: Eigenmath, symbolic math in the Terminal: derivatives, integrals, equations, matrices and exact numbers of any size. Type eigenmath for the prompt, or eigenmath -e 'd(sin(x)^2,x)' for one answer.
descriptions.it: Eigenmath, matematica simbolica nel Terminale: derivate, integrali, equazioni, matrici e numeri esatti di qualsiasi grandezza. Scrivi eigenmath per il prompt, oppure eigenmath -e 'd(sin(x)^2,x)' per una risposta.

does.en: Exact symbolic math: derivatives, integrals, roots, matrices, big integers, fractions. Run: eigenmath -e 'integral(x^2*exp(x),x)' (one -e per expression, one-line result).
does.it: Matematica simbolica esatta: derivate, integrali, radici, matrici, interi enormi, frazioni. Uso: eigenmath -e 'integral(x^2*exp(x),x)' (un -e per espressione, risultato su una riga).
